evidence.mission_note: A stock, roof-railed V8 4WD GX470 delivers rooftop-tent and sleeping-platform capability the RX lacks, so it fits the capability branch. It does nothing for the enthusiast bridge, and accelerated_bridge mode does not justify skipping a PPI.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a 2005 GX470 in blue-grey with grey leather, apparently stock, located in Santa Maria, CA, at $18,500 after a $2,500 reduction. Photos show a clean, consistent exterior at stock ride height with factory wheels and roof rails. They also show a dashboard cracked across the passenger airbag area, a cracking front seat bolster and stained carpets. There is no VIN, no history report and no service record. Clean title, original mileage and 'well cared for' are seller prose only. Every model-critical item is missing: the timing belt at 136k is past the 90k interval with no evidence either way, and the rear air suspension, radiator, underbody, tire dates and warning lights are all undocumented. The asking price sits in the upper part of the fair-value band (mid $16,704) with none of the documentation that usually supports that position.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, a timing-belt/water-pump invoice or sticker photo, a cold-start video with the cluster visible, and agreement to a PPI in Santa Maria before any deposit.
